description: GMB Club connects ChatGPT to your Google Business Profile and local marketing stack. Read and reply to Google reviews with AI-suggested replies, schedule and publish posts to Google, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and more, create and publish articles to your website, track SEO keywords and Search Console performance, monitor your local visibility, and send review requests to your customers. Everything is scoped to the business locations you explicitly authorize, and every action that publishes or sends something runs as a preview first and requires your confirmation.

defaultPrompt: Show my latest Google reviews and suggest replies to the ones I haven't answered yet
Create a social media post about our latest news and schedule it for the best time this week
How did my business perform on Google last month? Show me the key metrics and trends
